description: This file contains functions for parsing, building, merging, and normalizing legacy delivery hints and payloads, including handling of delivery modes, channels, and thread IDs, with utility functions for manipulating payload objects.

methods.name: parseLegacyDeliveryHintsInput
methods.description: Parses input payload to extract optional delivery hint fields with validation schemas.

methods.name: hasLegacyDeliveryHints
methods.description: Checks if the payload contains any legacy delivery hint fields.

methods.name: buildDeliveryFromLegacyPayload
methods.description: Constructs a delivery object from legacy payload hints, setting mode and optional fields.

methods.name: buildDeliveryPatchFromLegacyPayload
methods.description: Creates a patch object representing changes needed to update delivery hints based on payload.

methods.name: mergeLegacyDeliveryInto
methods.description: Merges patch updates into existing delivery object, indicating if mutation occurred.

methods.name: normalizeLegacyDeliveryInput
methods.description: Normalizes delivery input and payload, applying patches and stripping legacy fields.

methods.name: stripLegacyDeliveryFields
methods.description: Removes legacy delivery hint fields from payload object.
